title: Debibaran
desc: Satyapriyo fights for justice when his sister is raped. During his fight, he takes on a corrupt village official in a twisted turn of events.

title: Sati Behula
desc: Savitri is a devoted wife who roams about with her differently abled husband and stands by him despite his difficulties.

title: Boumar Banabash
desc: A royal couple faces divine punishment as the wife endures exile while the prince grapples with a mysterious curse that threatens both love and destiny.

title: Rajar Meye Parul
desc: A childless king marries a woodcutter's daughter to gain an heir. However, his wives kill his seven children, leaving only his daughter Parul, who grows up to be a charming young lady.

title: Abhimaan
desc: After disowning his daughter years ago, an elderly businessman now seeks the help of his grandson to mend his relationship with her.
